definition.description: A small, single-handed axe designed for quick, repeated strikes. Its light weight and short handle allow for fast swinging speed. Using a hatchet increases the plant harvest yield slightly.

resident.description: Her kufiya has been cut and resewn to a cowl, and she has tailored a vinewafer sack to approximate the slate habit of the chromaic people. A sheaf of watervine bundled in copper wire is slung on her hip, and she rubs a salt-nailed thumb over a talisman of cracked circuitboard.

The tatters of a sweat-stained kufiya thrash in the wind from where they hang about the farmer's neck. Clasped in her gnarled, brown hand is a curved vinereaper of iron with which she culls moisture-swollen wafers from the viridian plant called watervine.

He is a wind-carved man with the posture of a vinereaper; his spine is bent to point the bright turquoise of his eyes at the tilling angle, his hips are pushed odd-forward with the slumping ease of a stance much more relaxed than his. If it weren't for the salt on his brow and the scarred knuckles, he would seem a marble Saad perched under a crumbling tomb.
